text_blocks.snippet: Early signs of type 2 diabetes include increased thirst, frequent urination, and constant fatigue as outlined by the Mayo Clinic.
snippet_highlighted_words: increased thirst, frequent urination, and constant fatigue

list.snippet: Extreme thirst: You feel thirsty even after drinking plenty of water.
Frequent urination: You wake up at night to pee because your kidneys try to remove extra sugar.
Constant fatigue: You feel very tired because your cells do not get enough energy from glucose.
Blurry vision: High blood sugar causes fluid changes in the lenses of your eyes.
Slow-healing sores: Cuts, scrapes, or bruises take a long time to heal.
Dark skin patches: Velvety, dark skin appears on your neck or armpits, which signals insulin resistance.
Increased hunger: You feel hungry soon after eating because your body cannot use sugar properly.
